handback.t:
K4 (knowledge organization + extension) COMPLETE. Deliverables: results/k4_board_entry.md (4 VERIFY REQUEST blocks with exact rerun commands + numbers + negatives), results/lessons_k4.md, results/k4_summary.txt (Holm master tables), results/k4_fixtures.md5. Code: py/k4_{common,build,taxo,taxo_report,mh_prep,embed,links,links_qe,vers_prep,vers,extend,summary}.py. No src edits, no commits, no downloads; python-only, MiniLM via on-disk model. REAL text/structure/relevance (h10 A/B + h20 pydoc9/crates8 fixtures, cargo registry); outcome/demand models explicitly SYNTHETIC. Protocol: tune A seeds 1-8, held 31-60, confirm 61-90 (A fresh, B independent, pydoc9, crates8); paired t-CI + query/pair/crate-cluster bootstrap; Holm per family; TOST controls. Baseline = existing best flat hybrid z(.7)+BM25+spell (python replica).

HEADLINE: none of the four organisation levers beats flat retrieval on recall; two small conditional positives only.

1. AUTOMATIC TAXONOMY (k-means + c-TF-IDF + ward tree) + two-stage retrieval with cluster-confidence fallback: NEGATIVE. Tuned by "cheapest config within -0.005 MRR of flat". Frozen picks lose MRR@10 in 12/14 cells (Holm-sig): confirm crates8 -.019, pydoc9 -.013, A -.005/-.006, B -.003; hit@8 -.004..-.017; h20 e2e dq (SYNTHETIC) -.0002..-.0063; scan cost 84-96%. Auto-clusters aren't domains (NMI vs provenance .14-.37; track source docs .32-.57). Speed only buys recall loss (m=2/83 clusters=2.7% docs, 426 vs 1034 us/query, -.04..-.10 MRR). <=7k paragraphs needs no index.

2. KNOWLEDGE LINKS (file/section neighbours, rare terms, md links, Cargo deps) + link-expansion at EQUAL k=8 budget on multi-hop pairs (GT = linked section/crate): NEGATIVE with non-circular union graph (both-hop recall A held ADJ/SECNEXT/DEP -.022/-.021/-.004; confirm -.032/-.015/+.007; B -.001). POSITIVE only when graph IS the question's own structure (LE|adj on ADJ +.069/.045/.046; LE|dep on DEP +.014/.013) — circular, tiny vs oracle-edge ceiling +.19..+.25. Hop-1 recall only 32-52%, so expansion can't repair a missed first hop. Random-link control -.02; single-hop control TOST-equivalent (-.002). Graph query-expansion not link-specific (random neighbours +.007). r frozen=1 (no r wins on tune).

3. STALENESS/CONTRADICTION across real crate README versions (214 crates, 5548 paras, key=crate|heading|ordinal, masked changed-number/entity queries): small POSITIVE, tiny n. Flat returns stale paragraph 9-20%; key/semantic newest-wins resolver lifts answer-correct@1 .80->1.00 held (n=35, boot CI [+.03,+.44], Holm .044), .83->.91-1.00 confirm (n=23, ns). Signal "top-1 has newer same-key version" recall 1.0/precision .875 (NUM), 0.6% STABLE false flags, 0 ONLYOLD. Key 93.6% reliable. Opt-in verifier signal for versioned stores w/ current-answer intent; needs real traffic.

4. ACQUISITION POLICY (gap log = low top-1 cosine, detector AUC .68-.76; priority = softmax-cosine to unit abstracts; extend under budget vs random/recent/largest/oracle): SMALL positive under SYNTHETIC concentrated demand, NOT robust. gap-random coverage-AUC +.019/.068*/.082* held, +.024/.053*/.036*/.021 confirm (4/7 Holm-sig; recall 1/7). recent & largest = random or worse. FAILS controls: uniform TOST+-.02 holds 3/7; drift gap -.04..+.03. Oracle headroom +.41..+.48 (ranking realises ~5-18%). Advisory only.

DECISION: defaults unchanged, nothing applied to src, no proposed patch. Flat hybrid+spell stays. Only (c) structural-key staleness check and (d) label-free gap detection warrant opt-in follow-up pending real traffic.

Disclosed: fixed an off-by-one in links' fill-from-flat (had made 5 arms identical; all numbers from fixed rerun; r=1 pick unchanged); renamed a leaking topic arm (used failed queries' true topic) to topic_oracle, added legit label-free topic_pred; widened version queries before held run; stopped my own slow extend process (PID 11844), no other process touched.
